content.title: Chapter 38 - ENVIRONMENT — Sec. 38-245. - Rules and regulations.
content.summary:
The city may, from time-to-time, adopt rules and regulations governing the maintenance
               of landscaping within the city in accordance with secs.
2-141
—
2-145
of this Code.
(Ord. No.
4760
, § 1, 4-19-2021)
